UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile and lifetime career statistics for Horário de Pico: Briga no Busão.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

bestScore.description: Highest arcade score achieved by the player.

totalEnemiesDefeated.description: Cumulative count of enemies defeated across runs.

bestRushScore.description: Highest score achieved in Hora do Rush (infinite) mode.

bestRushWave.description: Highest wave reached in Hora do Rush (infinite) mode.

bestHitChain.description: Highest uninterrupted hit combo achieved across runs.

badges.description: Bounded allowlisted achievement medal IDs unlocked by the player (max 10).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public high-score entry for the bus commuter leaderboard.

bestHitChain.description: Highest uninterrupted hit combo achieved in Campaign mode.

badges.description: Bounded allowlisted achievement medal IDs displayed on the leaderboard (max 10).

GameRun.title: GameRun
GameRun.description: Individual match history record for a player.

enemiesDefeated.description: Number of enemies defeated during this run.

victory.description: Whether the player beat the final boss and clocked in.

gameMode.description: Game mode played during this run.

waveReached.description: Highest wave reached during an infinite Hora do Rush run.

bestHitChain.description: Highest uninterrupted hit combo achieved during this run.

badges.description: Bounded allowlisted achievement medal IDs earned in this run (max 10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the run was recorded.

RushLeaderboardEntry.title: RushLeaderboardEntry
RushLeaderboardEntry.description: Public high-score entry for the dedicated Hora do Rush infinite mode leaderboard.

bestScore.description: Best Hora do Rush run score.

bestWave.description: Highest wave reached in Hora do Rush.

enemiesDefeated.description: Enemies defeated in best Hora do Rush run.

bestHitChain.description: Highest uninterrupted hit combo achieved in Hora do Rush mode.

badges.description: Bounded allowlisted achievement medal IDs displayed on the Rush leaderboard (max 10).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the Rush record.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user profile and aggregate gameplay statistics.

/users/{userId}/runs/{runId}.description: Immutable match history records owned by the user.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Publicly readable high-score leaderboard entries for Campaign mode keyed by user UID.

/rush_leaderboard/{userId}.description: Publicly readable high-score leaderboard entries for Hora do Rush mode keyed by user UID.
